- Strengthened account key verification: now strictly prevents any fee estimation or pricing info from being shown before API Key is set.
- Updated guidance for users without an API Key—registration and key creation process is clearly separated and emphasized as free.
- Improved wording and stricter enforcement in the workflow around when fee displays and confirmations may occur.
- Removed the redundant file skill-card.md.
- Minor clarifications and ordering refinements in usage documentation.

wechat-ecosystem-data-hub v1.0.0

- Initial release providing unified access to all We-Media (曼格云) API endpoints for the WeChat ecosystem.
- Supports public accounts, Channels, Sogou search, WeChat Index, trending topics, mini-programs, AI video analysis, audio transcription, and more.
- User-friendly workflow: automatic API key validation, guided parameter selection, cost estimation before any paid request, and flexible output formats.
- Ensures explicit user confirmation before incurring costs; free endpoints work without confirmation.
- Includes clear error codes, cost-table, and step-by-step usage instructions.
